attchmntText: Ddev Plastiks Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Ddev Plastiks Industries Limited approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026 during its Board Meeting on 12th November 2026. Revenue from operations for the quarter was Rs. 97,836.39 lacs, with a profit after tax of Rs. 5,196.24 lacs. For the half year, revenue was Rs. 196,781.64 lacs, and profit after tax stood at Rs. 11,575.58 lacs. Earnings per share were Rs. 5.02 for the quarter and Rs. 11.19 for the half year. Total assets as of 30th September 2026 were Rs. 161,749.75 lacs. The statutory auditor issued a limited review report on these results. The financial statements are available on the company website and stock exchange portals.

Ddev Plastiks Industries Limited has informed the Exchange with copy of minutes of  Annual General Meeting held on September 26, 2026
